nodes.why: Initiating asset — ransomware directly compromises the State Load Dispatch Center control systems.
Regional Substation depends on SLDC for load-balancing signals; loss of dispatch control degrades substation stability.
Telecom Exchange relies on SLDC power feed; without grid dispatch, backup generators must sustain exchange loads.
Water Treatment Plant draws power from SLDC; treatment and dosing processes degrade without stable supply.
Rail Control Center depends on SLDC power and telecom signaling; partial loss of both reduces dispatchable capacity.
Mobile Tower Cluster depends on the Telecom Exchange for backhaul; exchange degradation reduces mobile coverage.
Regional Hospital depends on both power (via substation) and communications (via telecom exchange); loss of either threatens ICU and surgical loads.
Water Pump Network depends on the substation for power; reduced supply stability limits pumping throughput.
Government Data Center depends on telecom for WAN connectivity; loss of exchange links isolates regional services.
Ambulance Dispatch depends on hospital coordination and mobile tower coverage; degradation of both delays dispatch routing.
Emergency Operations Center depends on the data center for situational feeds; loss of data links reduces decision support.
Regional Bank depends on the data center for clearing and settlement; isolated WAN links slow but do not halt transactions.

actions.title: Activate hospital backup power
actions.description: Switch regional hospital to diesel generator and battery UPS to preserve ICU and surgical loads.

actions.title: Isolate telecom exchange fault domain
actions.description: Segment the affected exchange from the core fiber ring to prevent control-plane propagation.

actions.title: Reroute water plant to manual control
actions.description: Shift the treatment plant to manual dosing and open the secondary intake valve.

actions.title: Dispatch mobile cell-on-wheels unit
actions.description: Deploy a COW to maintain public safety communications near the incident zone.

actions.title: Failover data center to secondary site
actions.description: Redirect government data center workloads to the secondary availability zone.

brief.situation: A simulated ransomware event has compromised the State Load Dispatch Center, the primary power-grid control node. Projected impact propagates to the telecom, health, water, transport, data, public, and finance sectors within 95 minutes.
brief.projection: Without mitigation, 3 critical nodes and 9 total services are projected to degrade. The Regional Hospital reaches high risk by T+45 minutes. Cascade depth is 4 layers, with the Regional Bank as the deepest projected impact at T+95.
brief.recommendation: Prioritize P1 actions: activate hospital backup power and isolate the telecom exchange fault domain. These two actions are projected to reduce composite risk by approximately 27% and delay hospital impact to T+90.
brief.compliance: This scenario triggers NIS2 cross-sector dependency reporting and CISD critical-infrastructure notification thresholds. Simulated values are illustrative and require validation against live telemetry before operational use.
